---
title: "Baliza PNCP Sync Stats"
description: "High-level summary of the pipeline data"
output: /data/sync_stats.json
format: object
---

This block calculates the total stats directly from the manifest to prevent client-side JS freezing.

```{sql}
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(row_count) AS DOUBLE) as total_contracts,
  CAST(SUM(quarantine_count) AS DOUBLE) as total_quarantine,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS DOUBLE) as days_on_ia 
FROM manifest;
```
